NOTE
**Still not ready: the commit cleanup is done, but the PR doesn't say how it relates to the other open PRs for this issue**

New: The author squashed everything into one commit on current `main`, fixed multi-line text handling, added a test for it, and CI now passes. Missing: no explanation of how this differs from the open PRs #38098, #39481 and #39606 for the same issue, and the "Automated tests verify logic" box in the checklist is still unchecked even though the comment says the checklist is complete.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and have laurynmm (or whoever is triaging) send the reply below, since #38902 was closed for the same missing explanation.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for cleaning up the commit. Before we can review, please add a note to the PR description saying how this differs from the other open PRs for #19589 (#38098, #39481, #39606), as described in [continuing unfinished work](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html), and check off the remaining self-review item about automated tests.
```
